conventions.mag_db: 20*log10|H| of the traced biquad cascade (double precision, unclamped); if no cascade could be traced, the app's respf value (float, clamped +-48 dB)
conventions.phase_deg: arg H in degrees, wrapped to (-180,180]
conventions.biquads: [b0,b1,b2,a1,a2], H = (b0+b1 z^-1+b2 z^-2)/(1+a1 z^-1+a2 z^-2), float32 values as computed by WING-Edit
conventions.check_max_dev_db: max |app respf - cascade evaluated with the app's float32 omega/sincosf| (trace verification; curves are kept only if < 0.005 dB)
conventions.gui_vs_exact_max_db: max |app respf - exact double cascade| inside +-47.9 dB (GUI float32 rounding, worst for narrow low-frequency sections)
conventions.params: values read back from the Cpar after ncl::Cpar::set (i.e. quantised to the parameter grid)

sidechain.note: ch/*/gatesc uses the same code (usage 0 vs 1 only selects the biquad slot).

dyn_crossover.note: Ccompxover::getResponse(int ch, int usage, float f); 1 biquad at chdsp+0xdc. This is the detector/processing band filter of the dyn block (depth not in curve).
